source_title: LG Promo Codes and Coupons for October 2026
source_excerpt:
LG makes many of the best TVs you can buy. Its C-series TVs are our top pick for the best OLED TV and have been for quite some time. Pair it with one of the brand’s great soundbars , and you have a top-tier home theater setup that will last for years. While WIRED loves LG mostly for its TVs , the brand is an electronics giant that makes excellent computer monitors and very competitive home appliances like smart refrigerators . These are all big-ticket items, though, so here’s where to find LG promo codes and other ways to save on LG discounts for these often big-ticket items.
If you’re looking to save on LG gear today, you can get up to 20% back on your first order with select eligible products when you sign up for LG Rewards with your email address. Simply go to the My LG Rewards page , follow the instructions to sign up, and save.
If you’re ready to check out one of those TVs mentioned above, LG’s C4 and the ultra-bright step-up model G4 are both eligible right now in 77-inch sizes. Otherwise, there are plenty of other products currently on sale that you can stack with My LG Rewards for 5% back and points on every purchase.
Get a $200 Gift Card with NFL Shop eGift Card with LG TVs
Winter is around the corner, which means staying inside to avoid the cold and curling up to watch some football. Just in time for the season, you can get a $200 NFL Shop e-gift card and free installation when you purchase select LG OLED and QNED Mini LED TVs, including an LG OLED evo 4K TV and an LG Micro RGB evo AI 4K Smart TV. To claim your NFL Shop reward, buy a qualifying LG TV between September 14 and October 4, submit your claim within 30 days of purchase, and once your claim is approved, you’ll receive your reward within 45 days.
We love LG products, and we know you do too. This tech is often the priciest investment you’ll make for your household. So we snagged an LG secret coupon for you that gives 5% off your next purchase. Although it doesn’t sound like much, on a big appliance purchase like a laundry set or a range stove, this can add up to hundreds of dollars in savings. All you need to do is sign up to become a member, and you’ll get 5% off your purchase—but act quickly, because the offer is only good for 24 hours.
Watch for LG Fridge Deals and Price Drops
One of the most sought-after appliances from the brand is the LG refrigerator . While we don’t have any set LG promo codes and discounts for refrigerators right now, be sure to check back often and track price changes on these sought-after powerhouse appliances. The Counter-Depth French Door Refrigerator is a sleek, three-door stainless-steel machine with a built-in ice maker and a luxe mirror finish. The Side-By-Side InstaView Refrigerator is the fridge of the future, with a translucent door that lets you see what’s inside without opening it. The simple Single Door Refrigerator features a clean, compact design and easy-to-reach organization.
Students, Teachers, and First Responders Get a 10% Off LG Promo Code
Looking for more discounts? If you’re a teacher, student, or first responder, you could receive an additional LG Promo Code for extra savings. To check your eligibility, click the LG Appreciation Program link and follow the instructions to register your account. Exclusive discounts include free installation for refrigerators, cooking ranges, and washer/dryers, as well as select LG Studio and LG Signature appliances. You could also get year-round savings on LG products, with a minimum guaranteed discount of 10% compared to sale prices on their website.
If you’re an active member of the military or a veteran, you can also get 10% off with the LG military discount . All you need to do is verify your status at ID.me. Once your status is verified, you’ll register your LG account to start shopping for exclusive discounts and the latest offers. Plus, registered LG members will get additional benefits like free shipping, flexible payment options, exclusive discounts, free installation, and best price guarantees.
Get up to 20% Back With MyLG Rewards or 5% Off Referral Code
With MyLG Rewards, you can get up to 20% back in rewards , plus exclusive deals, extended warranties, and free installation. Eligible rewards members can get an additional 5% off LG products by referring a friend or loved one through the LG Referral program when they make an eligible purchase of $200 or more. They’ll get 5% off, and you’ll earn 5,000 MyLG Rewards points, so it’s a win-win. This coupon is stackable with other promotions, so you can still take advantage of the many other featured discounts.
LG wants to reward gamers. Right now, you’ll get a $200 gaming or MasterCard credit when you pre-order the 52-inch UltraGear evo monitor . This LG gaming monitor is the world’s largest 52-inch 5K2K screen, delivering epic ultra-wide scale and UHD detail, with a curve that wraps the action in UHD clarity across your natural view for an immersive gaming experience like never before. Plus, the built-in speakers deliver clear, well-balanced stereo sound, and the ability to adjust height, tilt, and swivel helps refine your gaming experience without adding desk clutter.
